THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation do hereby declare under Sub- section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The Allotments of land described as following name and extent depicted in the Advance Tracing No. MA/WLG/2021/460 dated 14.09.2022, of the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Iriyagas Ulpatha, in Hibiliyakada Grama Niladhari Division, E 396D, in Laggala Pallesiya Pattuwa Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Wilgamuwa, in Matale District, Central Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ - Iriyagas Ulpatha Kelaya - Extent: 0.0126 Hectare North: Iriyagas Ulpatha claimed by A.G. Bisomenika; East: Iriyagas Ulpatha claimed by A.G. Bisomenika and Lot B;

South: Iriyagas Ulpatha claimed by A.G. Bisomenika; West: Iriyagas Ulpatha claimed by A.G. Bisomenika. 02. Lot ‘B’ - Iriyagas Ulpatha Kelaya - Extent: 0.0205 Hectare North: Lot A and Iriyagas Ulpatha claimed by A.G. Bisomenika; East: Iriyagas Ulpatha claimed by A.G. Bisomenika and road; South: Iriyagas Ulpatha claimed by A.G. Bisomenika; West: Iriyagas Ulpatha claimed by A.G. Bisomenika. K.D. LAL KANTHA, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
